content: Weku hika muhika kaasi mwana
Amana tala buna nzodi yizimbula: tangwa dyosu dina kenina swana wa khunda, kaswaswaniku yi muhika, mbatanana kenina mukwa byawu byosu.
Kafeti lemvuka kwena batu bana bisi mutsasa, babana bisi sweka bima byandi yikuna dyalúngila tangwa dina kásya tata wandi.
Phila mosi phi yi betu, tangwa twákala bana bakhunda, twákala bahika ba ngolu za bitembu bya tsi
Kaasi ha dyálungila tangwa dina kásya, Nzambi wátuma Mwana wandi: kábutuka kwena mukhetu mosi amana kakala phi mu sina dya mitsiku mya Bayuta,
ndangu kalenga balubula babana bákala mu luyalu lwa mitsiku, twalenga bongila tsatsudi ya kukala bana ba Nzambi.
Amana mu kusongila ni mukyedika bana bandi lwenina; Nzambi wáhitika muna mbundu yetu Kitembu wa Mwana wandi, wuna wisi kalunga: «Aba! Tata!»
Yihana ni weku hika muhika kaasi mwana; amana yuka ni mwana wenina, wenina phi swana, mu mana matadidini Nzambi.
Pholu diyangisi kikuma kya bisi Ngalati
Mu tangwa dya khulu lwámuzayaku Nzambi, amana lwákala bahika ba bitembu bina byákalaku banzambi, kinga mu kyedika, beku banzambi.
Kaasi buthwena lumuzayini Nzambi, -kondilo, luzayakani kwena Nzambi- , Abweti hika lwavútwakila bitembu bina byakonda ngolu, byakonda kala mupfunu? Luzodi phi ni lwakituka bahika ba byawu?
Lwisi simbulula mboti-mboti bilumbu, ngonda, tsungi yi mvula!
Bweya yenina bwawu mu kudiheka phasi za phamba kikuma kya benu.
Kalenu hanga meni, kikuma meni phi yíkituka hanga benu. Yilubokwadidibwa, baphangi bama. Lwáphangaku keti mbi yimosi.
Luzayibwa ni kikuma kya kimbefu yílulongila Musamu wa Bukheti mbala ya theti.
Mbatanana kimbefu kya lutu lwama, benu lwámbengaku, lwámbwisaku phi, kaasi lwángyamba hanga wanzyo mosi wa Nzambi, holo hanga Yesu Kidisitu.
Amana ku biki lwasya kyesi kyenu kina? Mukuma ha mbati luheka kimbangi kyaki ni wadi bwalendakana, wadi lwakhana katula mesu menu ndangu lwaphekama!
Amana buthwena, khituki mbeni wenu kikuma kya buna yiluzimbwadini kyedika?
Tsambu ya batu babana yeku ya bukheti kikuma kya benu; bazodi lwesi ni baluhambula yi meni ndangu lwadihomba kwena bawu.
Bulungi ni lwabasa yi tsambu za bukheti mu matangwa moosu, ka kikuma ku lwesi kya buna yisi kala yi benu.
Bana bama, benu yisi yukila hika misongu mya kubuta, mina myatúla yi kuna lwakítukila hanga Kidisitu.
Nzodi buthwena yikala ha kati dya benu ndangu yilenga luzonzila mu mutindu wahika. Mukuma, mboniku buna yihánga kikuma kya benu.
Mbandu ya Akadi yi Sala
Nzimbwalenuti, benu lwisi tonda kukala ku sina dya mitsiku: lwisiku yuka buna mibati zimbula mitsiku meni mina?
Kikuma, bwabu bázimbula ni Bulahami kábuta bana boodi, mosi yi muhika, Akadi, mukwawu, kwena mukhetu wandi wa longu, Sala.
Kaasi mwana wuna kábuta yi muhika kábutuka bwosu buna bwisi butuka mwana wosu; kaasi wuna kábuta yi mukhetu wandi wa longu kábutuka mu kilangi kya Nzambi.
Mbandu za mbuta zenina muna mambu mana: mukuma bakhetu meni babana babati songila bulunda bwodi. Bumosi, bwabuna bwa ha mongu wa Sinayi yi Akadi; hanga wubuti lwesi bana ba kihika.
Kinga Akadi, yandi mongu wa Sinayi kuna Alabiya; amana lelu, wufwanakani yi mbanza ya Yelusalemi, mukuma mu kihika yenina yi bana bandi boosu.
Kaasi Yelusalemi dina dya ku zilu dyeku mu kihika, amana phi yandi ngudi wetu.
Kikuma masonuku mazimbudi bwabu:

content.text: Sika biyekiyeki, ngeyi wakonda yuka misongu mya kubutila!
Mukuma, bana ba mukhetu wuna bálosila bahitakani lawu kuluta babana ba mukhetu wuna wenina yi yakala dyandi.»

content: Kwena benu, baphangi bama, lwenina bana ba kilangi kya Nzambi hanga Yizaki.
Kaasi bwosu bwákala mbala yikwawu, mwana wuna wábutukila bwosu bwisi butuka mwana wosu kakala yangisa wuna wábutukila bwosu kyenina Kitembu kya Nzambi. Bwabuna bubati salama phi buthwena.
Kaasi biki mazonzi Masonuku? Bwabu: «Mukula muhika yi mwana wandi; mukuma, mwana muhika kalungiku mu kukala swana hakimosi yi mwana wa mukhetu wa longu.»
Yibwana, baphangi bama, betu thweku bana ba muhika, kaasi bana ba mukhetu wa longu.

footnotes.text: Ngolu za bitembu bya tsi: thendula ya mihowu myami yenina ya kubodika. Kamba Pholu kabati zonzila mitindu mya phila yi phila mya ngolu zina zisiku monika amana zazina zisi mukwata mutu mu kihika ku thwala ya kwisa kutumuka mu lukwikilu lwandi mwena Yesu Kidisitu. Khapu 4:9; Khl 2:8, 20.
